items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shares ten advances on long-open math and CS problems solved by internal Astra model
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布內部 Astra 模型解決十個長期開放數學與理論計算機科學問題的進展
items_flat.summary_en: On 1 August 2026 OpenAI published results from an internal version of its next major model Astra on ten problems that had seen no main-result progress for at least a decade. The results include new upper bounds on high-dimensional sphere packing, a construction of non-sofic groups, a disproof of Connes’s rigidity conjecture, improved permanent lower bounds, a quantum parallel-repetition theorem, and resolutions of several Erdős problems. Lean 4 formalizations, a 249-page manuscript and reasoning walkthroughs were released; total token cost was roughly $2,000 at Sol API rates.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月 1 日，OpenAI 公布其下一代主要模型 Astra 內部版本在十個至少十年無主要進展的開放問題上的結果，涵蓋高維球體堆積新上界、非 sofic 群構造、Connes 剛性猜想反證、算術電路複雜性下界、量子平行重複定理，以及多個 Erdős 問題的解決。已釋出 Lean 4 形式化證明、249 頁手稿與推理過程；總 token 成本約合 Sol API 費率 2,000 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is one of the clearest public demonstrations yet that frontier models can generate novel, formalizable results on hard open problems at modest cost. It elevates questions of attribution, verification standards and how mathematics will integrate AI-generated proofs while the model itself remains unreleased.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是目前最清晰的公開示範之一，顯示前沿模型能以相對低成本產出可形式化的新結果。它提升了歸因、驗證標準，以及數學界如何整合 AI 生成證明的問題，而該模型本身尚未公開發布。
items_flat.quote: The results were achieved by an internal version of Astra, our next major model. The total number of tokens needed to find solutions to these problems would cost roughly $2,000 at Sol API rates.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些結果由我們下一代主要模型 Astra 的內部版本完成。解決這些問題所需的 token 總數，以 Sol API 費率計算約為 2,000 美元。

items_flat.title_en: Minnesota AI nudification ban takes effect after judge denies xAI TRO
items_flat.title_zh: 明尼蘇達州 AI 裸化禁令生效，法官駁回 xAI 臨時限制令請求
items_flat.summary_en: Minnesota’s first-in-the-nation law (HF 1606) banning AI tools that generate non-consensual intimate imagery of real people took effect on 1 August 2026 after U.S. District Judge Donovan Frank denied xAI’s request for a temporary restraining order. The law carries civil penalties of up to $500,000 per violation. A hearing on a preliminary injunction is scheduled for 19 August.
items_flat.summary_zh: 明尼蘇達州全美首部禁止 AI 工具生成真實人物非自願親密影像的法律（HF 1606）於 2026 年 8 月 1 日生效。美國地方法官 Donovan Frank 駁回 xAI 的臨時限制令請求。違規可處最高 50 萬美元民事罰則。初步禁制令聽證會定於 8 月 19 日。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an early concrete test of state-level regulation of generative image models. It raises practical compliance questions for national platforms and leaves open whether the law will survive First Amendment challenges at the preliminary-injunction stage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是州層級規制生成式影像模型的早期具體測試。它對全國性平台提出實務合規問題，並留下該法在初步禁制令階段是否能通過第一修正案挑戰的不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Minnesota’s landmark law banning the use of nudification technology will go into effect tomorrow as planned. These nudification apps, including Grok Imagine, have been used to generate child sexual abuse materials and harass people in the vilest ways imaginable.
items_flat.quote_zh: 明尼蘇達州禁止使用裸化技術的里程碑法律將如期於明日生效。這些裸化應用（包括 Grok Imagine）曾被用來生成兒童性虐待材料，並以最卑劣的方式騷擾他人。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk claims Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 on speed and cost
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克聲稱 Grok 4.5 在速度與成本上為 Pareto 第一
items_flat.summary_en: On 1 August 2026 Elon Musk posted that “Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 when considering speed & cost,” quoting independent testing that ranked it the best frontier model under those constraints. The claim accompanies ongoing public promotion of Grok 4.5.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月 1 日，Elon Musk 發文稱「考慮速度與成本時，Grok 4.5 是 Pareto 第一」，引用獨立測試將其評為該限制下最佳前沿模型。此聲明伴隨 Grok 4.5 的持續公開推廣。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public Pareto claims keep competitive pressure on pricing and latency benchmarks, but independent third-party verification of the exact trade-off surface remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開的 Pareto 宣稱持續對定價與延遲基準施加競爭壓力，但對精確權衡曲面的獨立第三方驗證仍然有限。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 when considering speed & cost
items_flat.quote_zh: 考慮速度與成本時，Grok 4.5 是 Pareto 第一

brief_en: OpenAI’s unreleased Astra model delivered formal advances on ten decade-old math and CS open problems at ~$2k compute cost. Minnesota’s first-in-nation AI nudification ban took effect after a judge denied xAI’s TRO. Elon Musk claimed Grok 4.5 is Pareto-optimal on speed and cost.
brief_zh: OpenAI 未發布的 Astra 模型以約 2,000 美元計算成本，對十個長期開放的數學與理論 CS 問題提出可形式化進展。明尼蘇達州全美首部 AI 裸化禁令在法官駁回 xAI 臨時禁令後生效。馬斯克聲稱 Grok 4.5 在速度與成本上為 Pareto 第一。
